title: Kidokezo kingine cha hati ngumu kazini: soma kila sentensi kutoka kushoto

text.Another tip for difficult documents at w: Kidokezo kingine cha hati ngumu kazini: soma kila sentensi kutoka kushoto
text.A tip for reading difficult documents at: Kidokezo cha kusoma hati ngumu kazini, nambari 2 🐧
text.You know, when I am reading a document c: Unajua, ninaposoma hati bila uangalifu, wakati mwingi ninatenganisha na kusoma kutoka mahali fulani katikati. Bila kutambua, hutokea sana kwamba sisomi vizuri tangu mwanzo wa sentensi.
text.So, read the sentence properly from the: Kwa hivyo, soma sentensi vizuri kutoka kushoto.
text.When someone gets angry at me, I focus o: Mtu anaponikasirikia mimi huwa nazingatia badala ya kujilaumu
text.I want to decide once that my life is fu: Ninataka kuamua mara moja kwamba maisha yangu ni ya kufurahisha, na kuacha kuiangalia kila wakati
